values.task_boundary: Execute the Sprint 3 management closeout path after declared roster children have closed, retaining truthful evidence and stopping before any unsupported completion claim.
deliverables: Review/validation record for the sprint-level result
Typed publication and terminal closeout record when gates pass
acceptance_criteria: The closeout artifact records membership version 4 and all current roster children
Every child has live GitHub state and local lifecycle disposition recorded without overclaiming missing evidence
Child PR, merge, check, and ancestry evidence is retained or explicitly marked unavailable
The sprint result does not absorb child implementation or rerun paid/cloud work
Fresh sprint-end review finds no actionable findings before publication
Typed v2 publication and finish gates are used for the umbrella if review and validation pass
dependencies: #494 GCP-E GCP GPU readiness smoke test
non_goals: Paid cloud launch or live resource mutation
